from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess
root=Path.cwd();s=root/'.local/step07-ci-history';source=json.loads((s/'source-freeze.json').read_text())['sourceSHA'];assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()==source;assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],text=True).strip();sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
before=json.loads((s/'source-before.json').read_text());protected=[]
for n,r in before['files'].items():
 if n=='.github/workflows/ci.yml':continue
 raw=(root/n).read_bytes();assert sha(raw)==r['sha256'] and len(raw)==r['bytes'];protected.append({'path':n,**r})
product=[]
for n in subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-r','--name-only','59423201ba10ee71c3d1b04cebec69659017b7c7'],text=True).splitlines():
 if n=='README.md' or n.startswith('docs/') or n=='.github/workflows/ci.yml':continue
 raw=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','59423201ba10ee71c3d1b04cebec69659017b7c7:'+n]);actual=(root/n).read_bytes();assert actual==raw,n;product.append({'path':n,'sha256':sha(raw),'bytes':len(raw)})
assert len(product)==195,len(product)
workspace=s/'full-history-workspace';manifest=next(workspace.glob('artifacts/step07-'+source[:12]+'*/manifest.json'));j=json.loads(manifest.read_text());assert j['commit']==source and len(j['files'])==206
files=[]
for n,h in j['files'].items():
 live=(workspace/n).read_bytes();immutable=(manifest.parent/n).read_bytes();assert sha(live)==h and live==immutable,n;files.append({'path':n,'sha256':h,'bytes':len(live)})
old=root/'artifacts/step07-59423201ba10-191301abe69ac02e/manifest.json';oldRaw=old.read_bytes();assert sha(oldRaw)=='35fdc32783b4a07aff8a12bc3531385cc2dcb399f54d18da5fac1bdddd507814';oldj=json.loads(oldRaw);differences=[]
for n,h in oldj['files'].items():
 assert sha((root/n).read_bytes())==h,n
 if j['files'].get(n)!=h:differences.append(n)
assert differences==['apps/api/dist/resources/studio.json'],differences
oldResource=json.loads((root/'apps/api/dist/resources/studio.json').read_text());newResource=json.loads((workspace/'apps/api/dist/resources/studio.json').read_text());assert newResource['context']['commit']==source;newResource['context']['commit']=oldResource['context']['commit'];assert oldResource==newResource
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=workspace,text=True).strip();assert not(workspace/'.env').exists()
(stage:=s/'engineering-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps({'sourceSHA':source,'buildId':j['buildId'],'manifest':str(manifest.relative_to(root)),'manifestSHA256':sha(manifest.read_bytes()),'payloads':206,'files':files,'newArtifactDiskAndImmutableSHAEqual':True,'parentLiveDist206Unchanged':True,'oldManifestUnchanged':True,'newPayloadDifferenceFromR5':differences,'onlyResourceDifference':'context.commit binds new CI source commit; other resource content identical','targetProfileHash':'48844001eea07a8cf0da4baf9abb1653b01c38a9405413ed3123df189cf48793','buildWorkspaceClean':True,'isolatedBuildEnvCopied':False},indent=2)+'\n')
(s/'source-preservation.json').write_text(json.dumps({'sourceSHA':source,'parentProductSource':'59423201ba10ee71c3d1b04cebec69659017b7c7','onlyCodeChange':'.github/workflows/ci.yml','oldTrackedCount':len(before['files']),'protectedCount':len(protected),'protected':protected,'productAndTestConfigCount':195,'productAndTestConfigFiles':product,'allSourceBytesMatchR5':True,'legacyTestUnchanged':True,'liveParentDistUnchanged':206,'plansSchemaLockProfileCompilerSlotsClockUnchanged':True},indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'sourceSHA':source,'buildId':j['buildId'],'manifestSHA256':sha(manifest.read_bytes()),'payloads':206,'productSourceFiles':195,'protectedFiles':len(protected),'parentLiveDist206Unchanged':True}))
